**Publish gate report: search ad, Pebblebrook Tea Co.**

**Going out:** Google-style search ad, headline "Plastic-Free Tea Bags", description about plastic-free, home compostable tea bags and the 2019 Bristol founding. UK audience.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" | On policy list (tea bags are plastic-free) |
| "plastic-free and home compostable" | On policy list |
| "Founded in Bristol in 2019" | On policy list |

All three claims match the allowlist word for word, with no added qualifiers or superlatives.

**Regulated claims (environment):** "Plastic-free" and "home compostable" are specific, not broad "eco" or "green" claims, and the policy backs them. This is the lower-risk kind of environmental claim. No sign-off concern beyond the policy's standard approval.

**House style:** Plain, concrete, no banned words or AI tells. Fine for the format. Score is well above 80, no rewrite needed.

**Disclosure:** The ad is a paid search ad, and the platform labels it as an ad itself (the "Ad"/"Sponsored" marker). No creators, affiliates, gifted products or AI-generated imagery are involved, so nothing extra is needed in the copy.

**Fixed:** Nothing. No changes were needed.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing unresolved. One small note: the ad must not link to a page that fails to back these claims up, so the landing page should state the plastic-free and home compostable facts.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so the user (the account holder) needs to give an explicit yes to this exact copy. I have not recorded any approval, and nothing has been published. Once you confirm, the copy is clear to go.
